# opnsense_captiveportal_template (Resource)

Captive portal templates (Services > Captive Portal > Templates): a zip with a custom login page (`index.html` plus assets). Reference one by `id` in `opnsense_captiveportal_zone.template`. OPNsense removes files that match its default template before storing the zip, so changes made on the firewall are not detected; Terraform re-uploads when `content_base64` changes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_captiveportal_template" "example" {
  name           = "guest"
  content_base64 = filebase64("${path.module}/guest-portal.zip") # index.html plus assets
}

# Use it in a zone:
#   template = opnsense_captiveportal_template.example.id
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content_base64` (String) The template zip, base64 encoded, e.g. `filebase64("portal.zip")`.
- `name` (String) Template name.

### Read-Only

- `content_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of the decoded zip as configured.
- `file_id` (String) File ID OPNsense assigned to the template.
- `id` (String) UUID of the template.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID
terraform import opnsense_captiveportal_template.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
